The number of Brand1 laptops sold by A seller is how many more than the number of Brand2 laptops sold by B seller?

31:Tbf
solution:
**Calculation:**

Ratio of Brand1 : Brand2 laptops sold by Seller A = 3 : 1

The number of Brand1 laptops sold by seller A = 3/4 × 4000 = 3000

Ratio of Brand1: Brand2 laptops sold by Seller B = 2 : 1

The number of Brand2 laptops sold by seller B = 1/3 × 6000= 2000

Difference = 3000- 2000 = 1000

**∴ 1000 number of Brand1 laptops sold by seller is more than the number of Brand2 laptops sold by B seller.**
